subject.title: Improve macOS onboarding UX and gateway setup

question: Should maintainers retire this stale macOS onboarding branch as superseded, or ask the contributor for a full rebase with security/auth fixes and real macOS onboarding proof?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label blocks automated cleanup even though current main covers most of the useful direction and the branch still has P1 security/auth defects.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: Close this PR after a maintainer check, pointing contributors to the merged macOS setup and Crestodian onboarding paths already on main.

options.title: Request a rebased repair
options.body: Keep the PR open only if the contributor rebases onto current main, removes the duplicated/superseded pieces, fixes the security/auth findings, and adds live macOS proof.

options.title: Adopt manually
options.body: A maintainer can cherry-pick any uniquely desired UI detail into a fresh branch while preserving the current-main onboarding architecture.

recommendation.title: Close as superseded
recommendation.body: Close this PR after a maintainer check, pointing contributors to the merged macOS setup and Crestodian onboarding paths already on main.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the recent merged replacements and current-main maintenance for this macOS onboarding/gateway area.
